[Laptop required]
Build a team of AI agents, deploy them to the cloud, and watch them compete in live football matches. In this hands-on workshop, you write real agent code, deploy it to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and compete against AI opponents and other teams on a live 3D pitch. No AI or deep coding experience required. Through three phases—build, play, and optimize—you gain practical skills in multi-agent coordination, real-time reasoning, and production-grade deployment using Amazon Bedrock, Strands Agents SDK, and Kiro. Walk away with a working multi-agent system and patterns you can apply to any domain.

items.title: AWS Agentic Football Cup - [TR]

items.abstract: Building an AI agent takes weeks; running it reliably in production takes an entirely different approach. In this session, AWS introduces Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and its capabilities for deploying secure, scalable agents with any framework and model. Beko, a Fortune Global 500 appliances company, shares their journey from containerized agents on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate to a purpose-built agent runtime on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Learn how their Production Planning Supplier Agent handles thousands of isolated sessions across six factories, processes 450+ monthly supplier emails, and enforces governance through Cedar policies, session isolation, and full observability, all without managing infrastructure.

speakers.name: Alper Öner, Head of Artificial Intelligence, Beko
Zafer Sever, Senior Solutions Architect, AWS

items.title: How Beko runs production AI agents at scale with AgentCore - [TR]

items.abstract: Most AI agent projects stall when moving from prototype to production. This session tackles the top challenges builders face when deploying agentic AI at scale. You'll learn how to answer the fundamental question of whether to build custom agents or leverage pre-built agents for DevOps, security, development, and business productivity use cases. Then you'll discover how to address the critical production challenges of reliability, observability, cost management, security, and evaluation. Drawing from real customer deployments and AWS's portfolio of agentic AI capabilities, you'll gain actionable approaches for building agents that don't just demo well but ship and scale.

speakers.name: Kivanc Uslu, Senior Manager, Solutions Architecture, AWS

items.title: From Demo to Deployment: Solving Agentic AI's Toughest Challenges - [TR]

items.abstract: Most generative AI sessions feel like a 30-minute ad disguised as a talk. We changed that format. AI Spotlight: 8 companies, 10 minutes each, one framework; challenge, solution, result, metric. Hear from bitaksi, Etstur, Etiya, Insider One, Mavi, MDT, Migros One, and OPLOG. No fluff. No "we're exploring AI." Just what they built, what it solved, and what it measured. And here's the twist: the session itself runs on AI. Amazon Bedrock co-moderates live, generates real-time follow-up questions, and produces takeaway summaries as each story ends.

items.title: Generative AI Customer Spotlight: How They Achieved It - [TR]

items.abstract: In this session, learn how Migros One built SmartOne, an enterprise AI data agent using a Deep Agents architecture with the LangGraph SDK on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. We'll walk through how SmartOne connects enterprise data, business definitions, and domain knowledge through a single conversational interface, and how the team achieved enterprise-wide adoption across all business units. We'll also explore MAYA, a conversational shopping assistant built natively on AgentCore with personalized memory capabilities. Discover how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore enables managed scalability, runtime traceability, and production-grade governance for enterprise agentic AI at scale.
